items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Freddie Gould, yeah. Yeah, I know him.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Freddie that played guitar from the Ninth War? Played with his fingers sometimes, I said, no pity. Freddie? Freddie Gould.
Freddie Gould, yeah. Yeah, I know him.
Yeah, did you ever play with him?
